units: Targ. Jer. XIII, 17 (ed. Wil. ותְשַׁגֵּד Pa., shed).
Ib. IX, 17 (ed. Wil. Pa.).
<cite ref="Chullin 51a:9">Ḥull. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>דהוו שָׁגְרָן וכ׳</he> Tosaf. (ed. <he>שדרן</he>) they dragged their hind legs.

senses.gloss: to cause to run, shed tears. tears. Targ. Jer. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 23:20">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 20</cite>.

senses.gloss: to cast; (of beasts) to give birth. Ib. XIII, 12 דמְשַׁגְּרָא (not דמִשַּׁ׳).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 22:19">Targ. Jer. XXII, 19</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְשַׁגַּד</he>; f. <he>מְשַׁגְּרָא</he>; pl. <he>מְשַׁגְּרָן</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 7:33">Ib. VII, 33</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 36:30">XXXVI, 30</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 5:25">Targ. Is. V, 25</cite>, a. e.

senses.gloss: (neut. verb.) to run over. Y. Sabb. VIII, 9ᵇ bot. אַשְׁגְּרַת עיינה דר׳ וכ׳ R. Aḥa’s eye ran over the whole Torah, and he did not find (that the word מלאכה appeared 39 times).
to cast an eye. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot. בהיא שעתא אַשְׁגְרִית עיניי וכ׳ (not עינוי) at that moment I let my eyes run (reviewed in my mind) the whole &c., v. תְּהִלָּה.
to improvise, change the established form of a prayer. Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ א׳ חד ברכה (read חדא) he changed one section of the Benedictions.
units: Ib. א׳ מכניע זדים בסופה he changed the benediction which closes with makhniʿa zedim (the twelfth section) at the end of it.
